s: Which of the following gives information about local self-government during the Chola period?
x:
The famous Uttaramerur Inscription of the Chola period provides the most detailed information about the village self- government system in medieval South India. It explains: • Formation of village assemblies (Sabhas) • Qualifications and disqualifications for membership • Election through the Kudavolai System • Functions of various administrative committees dealing with irrigation, gardens, justice and finance The Uttaramerur inscription is considered one of the finest examples of democratic local administration in ancient India.
Hence, the correct answer is
Option (3).
n: Uttaramerur Inscription → Chola Local Self- Government
